question: Which of the following players broke National Record in Women’s 3000 m steeplechase at Doha Diamond League 2025 and qualified for the World Athletics Championships?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Parul Chaudhary**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Parul Chaudhary** is a prominent Indian athlete specializing in middle and long-distance running events.
 
• She broke the **National Record in the Women’s 3000 m steeplechase** at the **Doha Diamond League 2025**.
 
• This achievement allowed her to qualify for the prestigious **World Athletics Championships**, showcasing her exceptional performance on an international platform.
 
• The **3000 m steeplechase** is a unique track and field event that combines running with obstacles such as hurdles and water jumps, requiring both endurance and agility.
 
• Her record-breaking performance reflects her dedication and rigorous training in this demanding discipline.
 
• The **Doha Diamond League** is an annual athletics event that attracts top athletes from around the world to compete in various track and field events.
 
• Parul’s success contributes significantly to the growing prominence of Indian athletes in global athletics competitions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Chaitali Borekar**__

 __
 
• **Chaitali Borekar** is an Indian runner known for her participation in middle-distance events.
 
• Although talented, she has not achieved a national record in the **3000 m steeplechase** or qualified for the **World Athletics Championships** as of now.
 
 
 
• **Garima Yadav**__
 __
 
• **Garima Yadav** is another Indian athlete who competes in long-distance running events.
 
• She has showcased potential but is yet to make her mark in events like the **3000 m steeplechase** at international levels.
 
 
 
• **Ekta Pradeep Dey**__
 
 
• **Ekta Pradeep Dey** is a promising Indian runner with expertise in various track events.
 
• She has not been associated with breaking records in the **3000 m steeplechase** or qualifying for the **World Athletics Championships**.
